population_replicate_note: All three licensed sources are from the same Fukushima/Aizu locality, date (2008-10-01) and photographer (Qwert1234); they are image replicates, not independent population replicates.

validation.commons_metadata_check: Three files independently verified in CI as Fukushima/Aizu and CC BY-SA 4.0 before original-image download.

promotion_gate.reason: Only one of three images clears the frozen confidence floor, all three come from one locality/date/photographer, and the images were not produced by the original detector-crop cohort.

next_evidence: Acquire independent Japan-local C. pendulum populations with reusable or directly collected images under the same measurement protocol before promoting JPN_38 to a population-matched Japan38 colour tip.
claim_boundary: Derived screening calibration only. Raw external images are not committed. The usable L* value must not replace the canonical global species median or be treated as a Japanese population phenotype until independent local replication is obtained.
